messages.subject: blavaan 0.5-9

blavaan 0.5-9 is now on CRAN. It includes bug fixes (including recent bugs discussed here) and some internal improvements.

It is also the 10th anniversary of blavaan: the package first appeared on CRAN on Oct 7, 2015!

Ed
